description: SYSREQ_TURN_SIGNAL_SIGNALING (Turn Signal Indication): When the driver asserts a left or right turn intention, the system shall illuminate only the front and rear turn indicator lamps on the side matching the active turn input.

SYSREQ_HAZARD_LIGHT_SAFETY (Hazard Light Safety): When the hazard light button is activated, the Body Control Module shall command simultaneous left and right turn indicator activation within one signal processing cycle.
metadata.name: RemotiveCar_Lamp_RearLeftTurn_NotActivated
